license.excludes: Quoted source passages and linked articles remain the copyright of their publishers; they are included as short quotations for verification. Linked media and satellite images remain the rights holders' property; no image or video licence is granted by this dataset. Fonts (SIL OFL) and map data (Natural Earth, public domain) keep their own terms. City and region names in automatically published dossiers are checked against GeoNames (geonames.org, CC BY 4.0). Drone drawings and animations are schematic illustrations of a type, not evidence about any incident.

note: Coordinates are public dossier coordinates rounded to a 0.1-degree grid, not exact incident sites or trajectories. Grid rounding is not a confidence radius. Null geometry means no valid dossier coordinates; display reference points are never substituted for incident locations. Calendar dates/windows retain their original meaning. This is the DroneLedger archive, not a worldwide incident census. Unknown status is not a negative finding.
